11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3365|40134f65.name: Karolek
3365|40134f65.text: You won't learn anything new from me; you know too much already. If you want more training, talk to the tauren Una in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Send her my regards, eh?

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3399|48c1c064.name: Zamja
3399|48c1c064.text: Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

3413|c879b3f9.name: Sovik
3413|c879b3f9.text: Hello, $N! If you don't see it in my shop, chances are good I can get it!

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

1060-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
1060-accept.text:
You've done so well for me, $N. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
1060-accept.title: Letter to Jin'Zil

3924-complete.name: Rilli Greasygob
3924-complete.text:
You got the manual!  I can't wait to read it and find out how to fix the Samophlange!  I spoke with Sputtervalve in Ratchet--he wanted to thank you for your help, and wanted to reward your efforts.

I want to thank you too, and if I ever get this thing fixed I'll let you know...
3924-complete.title: Samophlange Manual

6461-accept.name: Xen'Zilla
6461-accept.text:
We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.

Lately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.

If you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.
6461-accept.title: Blood Feeders

6523-accept.name: Kaya Flathoof
6523-accept.text:
Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.

My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
6523-accept.title: Protect Kaya

6548-complete.name: Makaba Flathoof
6548-complete.text: $N, I thank you... but I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
6548-complete.title: Avenge My Village

6629-accept.name: Makaba Flathoof
6629-accept.text:
$N, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village.

You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
6629-accept.title: Kill Grundig Darkcloud

876-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-complete.text: HA! Well done, $N! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
876-complete.title: Serena Bloodfeather

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

95508-accept.name: Walton
95508-accept.text:
Yes, I used to be a member of the Kul Tiras navy. After Lord Admiral took Theramore and started his campaign in Durotar, I had... "objections" to his methods. Particularly the methods involving executing civilians.

There's more to the story but... wait... what's that?

There's a group of men coming up the ridge!
95508-accept.title: Unwelcome Guests

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

97275-accept.name: Yelmak
97275-accept.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275-accept.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-complete.name: Whuut
97275-complete.text:
Grorru--whaa?

You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.

Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.

$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275-complete.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-progress.name: Whuut
97275-progress.text: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275-progress.title: Whuut's the Rush
